Selected work

A taste of what the studio shoots. These are stock photographs for the sample. Raap's own photographs replace them on the live site.

What we shoot

One studio for the whole occasion, from the first portrait to the final album.

Wedding photography & cinematography

Candid and traditional coverage of the ceremony, rituals and reception, with a film that tells the day back.

Candid photography

Unposed, in-between moments: laughter, tears and the glances people miss on the day itself.

TR photography

Traditional frames, posed family photographs and the formal shots every album needs.

Drone coverage

Aerial views of the venue, the baraat and the whole celebration from above.

Live coverage

Live display of the event as it happens, for guests in the hall and family watching from elsewhere.

LED wall & albums

An 8 by 12 LED wall for the venue, and albums in lightweight, non-tearable PVC and HD finishes.

Wedding films

Films that show the day as it felt

A short film carries what photographs cannot: vows, music and movement. Press play to watch a sample. A Raap's wedding film replaces it on the live site.

Sample film by Ron Lach, via Pexels. Tap play to watch.

How booking works

Four steps, no confusion.

1

Enquire

Message on WhatsApp or call with your date, venue and the services you need.

2

Plan

Confirm the services, the visit timings and the album, and lock the date.

3

Shoot day

The team covers the event: candid, traditional, drone, live and LED wall as booked.

4

Delivery

Edited photographs, films and albums are delivered after the shoot. The delivery timeline is shared at booking.

Questions, answered

Where is the studio?

1st Floor, Above HP Gas, Osmania University Road, Vidya Nagar, Adikmet, Hyderabad 500044.

What are the studio hours?

Monday, Wednesday to Sunday, 9 AM to 9 PM. Tuesday closed.

How is a visit charged?

Per visit, as shown on the rate card. Most services are priced for a 4 hour visit. TR photography is priced per visit.

Which album should I choose?

Lightweight albums are ₹400 per sheet, non-tearable PVC prints are ₹450 per sheet, and HD albums are ₹750 per sheet. Ask on WhatsApp to see the finishes before deciding.

How do I book?

WhatsApp or call +91 98492 61325 with your date and venue. Confirm the services and the album, then lock the date.
